name: Animals in Sculpture — every item (map)
description: Every video and card of the Animals in Sculpture folder in one place: each of its 15 playlists is a chapter that folds open in the sidebar, and each item links to its place in its own playlist. A snapshot built from the folder; rebuild it after the playlists change. The folder itself: https://recursive.eco/explore?repository=b3056f6b-e377-4a9b-9705-199a127dd4d7
